hero.title: Eco-One™ for landfill biodegradation
hero.tagline: Same product. Same performance. Made with recycled EVA and Eco-One™.
hero.body: Our urinal screens and fresheners are made with recycled EVA. The material itself can be recycled, but a used urinal screen cannot, because it is biologically contaminated. It ends up in landfill or incineration, and that is why we add the Eco-One™ additive to all our products. In an independent test under ASTM D5511 and ISO 15985 at the Instituto Politécnico Nacional in Mexico City, ëkcos EVA with Eco-One™ reached 93% biodegradation within 3.5 years, while the same material without the additive showed 0%. Up to 99% biodegradation is projected within 5 years. Our boxes are made from 100% recycled cardboard.

problem.title: Why ordinary plastic is a problem
problem.body: Ordinary plastic products are engineered to last. Without a biodegradation additive, a plastic product sent to landfill can remain there for <bold>300 to 1,000 years</bold>; foam “Crocs-style” clogs are a familiar example of plastic that is <bold>not biodegradable</bold>. Our products are made from the same kind of durable plastic (EVA) — but with one decisive difference: the Eco-One™ additive.
problem.chartAlt: Products without Eco-One™ compared with ëkcos products containing the additive
problem.chartCaption: Products without Eco-One™ compared with ëkcos products containing the additive.

chart.ariaLabel: Comparison of years to break down in landfill
chart.withoutDetail: Without a biodegradation additive, conventional plastic can remain in landfill for centuries.
chart.withDetail: With the Eco-One™ additive, independent testing shows ~93% biodegradation in about 3.5 years, and up to 99% within five years.
chart.caption: Products without Eco-One™ compared with ëkcos products containing the additive.

solution.title: Our solution: The Eco-One™ additive
solution.body1: During manufacturing we incorporate approximately <bold>1% of Eco-One™</bold>, an organic additive dosed in the same way as a colorant. It does not affect the product’s strength, appearance or performance.
solution.body2: In a biologically active landfill, naturally occurring microorganisms break down the treated plastic through enzymatic activity, converting it into biogas (<bold>methane</bold>, which modern landfill sites capture for energy recovery), carbon dioxide and humus.
solution.body3: Because the product ultimately breaks down into humus, it returns organic matter to the landfill and helps accelerate the biochemical processes already at work there. The product therefore contributes <bold>not only during its service life, but also after it</bold>.

testing.title: Independent testing
testing.body: The product was tested by an independent laboratory to the international standards <bold>ASTM D5511 and ISO 15985</bold>, comparing the same product with and without the Eco-One™ additive. With Eco-One™, it reached <bold>93.31% biodegradation within approximately 3.5 years, and up to 99% within five years</bold>; without Eco-One™, the product showed no measurable biodegradation.

barChart.withDetail: 93.31% biodegradation measured in an independent ASTM D5511 / ISO 15985 lab test after about 3.5 years.
barChart.withoutDetail: The same product without Eco-One™ showed no measurable biodegradation over the same test period.
barChart.subtitle: Same product · same lab test (ASTM D5511 / ISO 15985) · ~3.5 years

timelineChart.ariaLabel: Biodegradation over five years with and without Eco-One™
timelineChart.caption: Biodegradation with and without the Eco-One™ additive. Values beyond 3.5 years are projected from the measured trend.

closing.title: ëkcos products with Eco-One™
closing.body: Our washroom products are manufactured with the Eco-One™ additive. In an independent laboratory test, ëkcos EVA with Eco-One™ reached 93% biodegradation within 3.5 years, and up to 99% is projected within 5 years in landfill conditions — with performance identical to products without the additive.

ecoOne.footnote: Data source: independent biodegradation test per ASTM D5511-02 and ISO 15985:2014 (Instituto Politécnico Nacional, Mexico City) — ëkcos product with 1% Eco-One™ additive: 93.31% biodegradation over 1,288 days (≈3.5 years); the same product without the additive: 0%. Biodegradation beyond the test period (up to 99% within ~5 years) is projected from the measured trend. Persistence figures for conventional plastics (≈300–1,000 years) are widely cited industry estimates. The Eco-One™ additive is manufactured and certified by EcoLogic, LLC.

Its patented bristles (Sealed Bristles Technology™) cover 92% of the screen and minimize urine splashback and unpleasant odors. Designed for high-traffic restrooms in restaurants, bars, airports, and shopping malls, xcrën HD 60+ combines hygiene with a look that sets the restroom apart.

It ends up in landfill or incineration, and that is why xcrën HD 60+ contains the Eco-One™ additive. In an independent laboratory test, ëkcos EVA with Eco-One™ reached 93% biodegradation within 3.5 years, and up to 99% is projected within 5 years.

ezTrap.name: ëz trap
ezTrap.imageAlt: White ëz trap waterless urinal cartridge with a black seal, photographed at an angle on a black background
ezTrap.short: ëz trap is an innovative cartridge system designed to enhance the efficiency, cleanliness, and odor control of waterless urinals while significantly reducing maintenance costs.
ezTrap.long:
ëz trap is an innovative cartridge system designed to enhance the efficiency, cleanliness, and odor control of waterless urinals while significantly reducing maintenance costs.

Featuring the patented ëz trap Cartridge System, it allows urine to flow naturally through the siphon, with a closing cap that seals after each use. This prevents odors from escaping and ensures that with every use, old urine is removed from the system, maintaining a fresher restroom environment.

ëz trap is made with the Eco-One™ additive, which makes it biodegradable in landfill. In an independent laboratory test, ëkcos material with Eco-One™ reached 93% biodegradation within 3.5 years, and up to 99% is projected within 5 years.

ëz trap offers an efficient, low-maintenance, and cost-saving way to keep drain odors out of waterless urinals.

benefits.1: No need for costly gels or specialized cleaners
benefits.2: Easy and cost-effective maintenance: simply pour a glass of water daily to prevent calcium buildup
benefits.3: Long-lasting durability: the cartridge lasts 4 to 6+ months, and regular cleaning with an anti-calcium agent (e.g., quality toilet gel) extends its lifespan
benefits.4: Wide compatibility: suitable for Sloan, Falcon, Vitra, Bobrick, and other brands using the Falcon Velocity system (diameter 11.8 cm, height 11.5 cm)
benefits.6: Packed in boxes made from 100% recycled cardboard
benefits.7: Biodegradable in landfill with the Eco-One™ additive

xcrenPuck.name: xcrën puck
xcrenPuck.imageAlt: Blue xcrën puck X-shaped urinal screen with a central puck holder, seen from above on a black background
xcrenPuck.category: X-shaped urinal screen with a deodorizing puck
xcrenPuck.short: xcrën puck is a urinal screen with a NON-PARA deodorizing puck, designed for effective odor control and drain protection. It contains no paradichlorobenzene (PARA), which the WHO classifies as possibly carcinogenic. PARA pucks are still used in some urinal screens, while EU rules restrict PARA in toilet deodorizers. Its X-shaped design stops solids and debris from clogging the drain, and it releases a clean, fresh fragrance with each use for up to 30 days.
xcrenPuck.long:
xcrën puck is a urinal screen with a NON-PARA deodorizing puck, designed for effective odor control and drain protection. It contains no paradichlorobenzene (PARA), which the WHO classifies as possibly carcinogenic. PARA pucks are still used in some urinal screens, while EU rules restrict PARA in toilet deodorizers. Its X-shaped design stops solids and debris from clogging the drain, and it releases a clean, fresh fragrance with each use for up to 30 days.

The puck is made mainly from wax and glycerin and dissolves with use. xcrën puck is made with the Eco-One™ additive, which makes it biodegradable in landfill. In an independent laboratory test, ëkcos material with Eco-One™ reached 93% biodegradation within 3.5 years, and up to 99% is projected within 5 years. It is a disposable product, and the puck cannot be replaced with a new one.

xcrën puck is a simple, effective way to keep urinals fresh and drains clear for up to 30 days.
